claims.name: current-version-shown
claims.risk: the install, quickstart or FAQ page, built from content/ by the seed's generator, still shows 2.4.1 or does not show 3.0.0 (site/ edited by hand, or a place missed)
command: exec python3 -I -B "${OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR:?the runner sets OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR}/checks/docs.py" version

claims.name: history-kept
claims.risk: the changelog or the migration guide no longer shows what the seed's does (a blind replace of 2.4.1)
command: exec python3 -I -B "${OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR:?the runner sets OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR}/checks/docs.py" history

claims.name: site-matches-source
claims.risk: site/ is not what content/ builds: hand-edited output, or content changed and not rebuilt
command: exec python3 -I -B "${OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR:?the runner sets OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR}/checks/docs.py" site

claims.name: build-kept
claims.risk: the generator, its template, the Makefile or CI was changed, in the working tree or at HEAD
command: exec python3 -I -B "${OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR:?the runner sets OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR}/checks/docs.py" build
